verdict.rationale: Xero documents bill capture by upload or email forwarding, with AI extraction into draft bills 'ready for approval'. It also supports paying multiple bills at once through an exported batch payment file that marks bills as paid, plus duplicate-bill detection. However, approval is mentioned only as a draft state with no evidence of routing to specific approvers. Payment works by uploading a file to online banking, not by scheduling payments inside Xero, so the 'one workflow' claim holds only in part. Missing for 10: configurable approval routing/approvers, in-product payment scheduling (dated or scheduled payments), independent or hands-on corroboration.
